caption:
Inflation is 3.8% and your raise has to beat it. 📈
The Fed's favorite gauge (PCE) rose 3.8% over the past year through October, per the BEA.
If your last raise was smaller than that, your paycheck buys a bit less than before.
Did your raise beat 3.8% this year?
first_comment: Be honest: did your raise beat 3.8%? 👇
